text.tk:
«To be» işliginiň öten zamany iki görnüşde bolýar:

• was — I, he, she, it bilen
• were — you, we, they bilen

I was at home. — Men öýde boldum.
They were happy. — Olar şat boldular.

Inkär: was not = wasn't, were not = weren't.
Sorag: Was she at school? — Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
text.ru:
У глагола «to be» в прошедшем времени две формы:

• was — с I, he, she, it
• were — с you, we, they

I was at home. — Я был(а) дома.
They were happy. — Они были счастливы.

Отрицание: was not = wasn't, were not = weren't.
Вопрос: Was she at school? — Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.

text.tk:
Häzirki zamandan öten zamana geçirýäris:
1) I am tired. → I was tired yesterday.
2) We are in the park. → We were in the park yesterday.
3) It is cold. → It was cold yesterday.
Düzgün: am, is → was; are → were.
text.ru:
Переводим из настоящего в прошедшее:
1) I am tired. → I was tired yesterday.
2) We are in the park. → We were in the park yesterday.
3) It is cold. → It was cold yesterday.
Правило: am, is → was; are → were.

explain.tk: He bilen «was»: My brother was at school yesterday.
explain.ru: С he используется «was»: My brother was at school yesterday.

explain.tk: We bilen «were»: We were in Ashgabat last summer.
explain.ru: С we используется «were»: We were in Ashgabat last summer.

explain.tk: Ýalňyş. «You» hemişe «were» bilen: You were late.
explain.ru: Неверно. «You» всегда с «were»: You were late.

text.tk: Iňlis dilinde «to be» — iň köp ulanylýan işlik. Ol düzgünsiz işlikleriň iň düzgünsizi: onuň be, am, is, are, was, were, been, being ýaly sekiz görnüşi bar.
text.ru: Глагол «to be» — самый частый глагол английского языка. И самый неправильный: у него восемь форм — be, am, is, are, was, were, been, being.

text.tk:
Düzgünli işlikler öten zamanda «-ed» goşulmasyny alýar. Ähli ýüzler üçin görnüş birmeňzeş:

• play → played
• watch → watched

Ýazuw düzgünleri:
• Soňy «e» bolsa diňe «-d»: like → liked, dance → danced
• Çekimsiz + «y» bolsa «y» → «ied»: study → studied, cry → cried
• Gysga söz: çekimli + çekimsiz bolsa çekimsiz goşalanýar: stop → stopped

Geçen wagt sözleri: yesterday, last week, ago.
text.ru:
Правильные глаголы в прошедшем времени получают окончание «-ed». Форма одна для всех лиц:

• play → played
• watch → watched

Правила написания:
• Если в конце «e», добавляем только «-d»: like → liked, dance → danced
• Согласная + «y» → «ied»: study → studied, cry → cried
• Короткое слово на гласную + согласную — согласная удваивается: stop → stopped

Слова-подсказки: yesterday, last week, ago.

text.tk:
Düýnki günüňi gürrüň ber:
1) I clean my room every day. → Yesterday I cleaned my room.
2) She helps her mum. → Yesterday she helped her mum.
3) We study English. → Yesterday we studied English.
Üns ber: öten zamanda «she» bolsa-da «-s» goşulmaýar.
text.ru:
Расскажи о вчерашнем дне:
1) I clean my room every day. → Yesterday I cleaned my room.
2) She helps her mum. → Yesterday she helped her mum.
3) We study English. → Yesterday we studied English.
Обрати внимание: в прошедшем времени даже с «she» не добавляем «-s».

hint.tk: «y»-dan öň çekimli «a» bar, şonuň üçin «y» üýtgemeýär.
hint.ru: Перед «y» стоит гласная «a», поэтому «y» не меняется.

explain.tk: play + ed = played. Çekimli + y bolanda diňe «-ed» goşulýar.
explain.ru: play + ed = played. После гласной + y просто добавляем «-ed».

explain.tk: bake soňy «e» bilen gutarýar, diňe «-d» goşulýar: baked.
explain.ru: bake оканчивается на «e», добавляем только «-d»: baked.

text.tk: Iňlis dilindäki işlikleriň aglabasy düzgünli, ýöne iň köp ulanylýan işlikleriň köpüsi düzgünsiz: go — went, see — saw, have — had. Täze döreýän işlikler bolsa hemişe düzgünli bolýar: email → emailed, text → texted.
text.ru: Большинство английских глаголов правильные, но многие самые частые — неправильные: go — went, see — saw, have — had. А новые глаголы всегда правильные: email → emailed, text → texted.

text.tk:
Iki zady deňeşdirmek üçin sypatlary üýtgedýäris we «than» (-dan/-den) sözüni ulanýarys.

• Gysga sypatlar: + «-er»: tall → taller, fast → faster
• Soňy «e»: + «-r»: nice → nicer
• Çekimsiz + y: y → «ier»: happy → happier, easy → easier
• Çekimli + çekimsiz: goşalanýar: big → bigger, hot → hotter
• Uzyn sypatlar: «more» + sypat: beautiful → more beautiful
• Düzgünsiz: good → better, bad → worse

An elephant is bigger than a dog.
text.ru:
Чтобы сравнить два предмета, меняем прилагательное и используем «than» (чем).

• Короткие прилагательные: + «-er»: tall → taller, fast → faster
• На «e»: + «-r»: nice → nicer
• Согласная + y: y → «ier»: happy → happier, easy → easier
• Гласная + согласная: удвоение: big → bigger, hot → hotter
• Длинные прилагательные: «more» + прилагательное: beautiful → more beautiful
• Исключения: good → better, bad → worse

An elephant is bigger than a dog.

text.tk:
Deňeşdirýäris:
1) Merdan is 140 cm. Aman is 130 cm. → Merdan is taller than Aman.
2) A car is fast. A plane is very fast. → A plane is faster than a car.
3) Summer in Ashgabat is hot. → Summer is hotter than spring.
Üns ber: «than» sözüni unutma!
text.ru:
Сравниваем:
1) Мердан — 140 см. Аман — 130 см. → Merdan is taller than Aman.
2) A car is fast. A plane is very fast. → A plane is faster than a car.
3) Summer in Ashgabat is hot. → Summer is hotter than spring.
Не забывай слово «than»!

q.tk: A cat is ___ than a mouse.
q.ru: A cat is ___ than a mouse.

explain.tk: good → better. Mysal: This book is better than that one.
explain.ru: good → better. Пример: This book is better than that one.

q.tk: This flower is ___ than that one.
q.ru: This flower is ___ than that one.

text.tk: Gepard — gury ýerde iň çalt haýwan: ol gysga aralykda sagatda 100 km-den hem çalt ylgap bilýär. A cheetah is faster than a car in the city!
text.ru: Гепард — самое быстрое сухопутное животное: на короткой дистанции он бежит быстрее 100 км/ч. A cheetah is faster than a car in the city!

text.tk:
Şäher hakda sözler:
• school — mekdep
• hospital — hassahana
• library — kitaphana
• park — seýilgäh
• museum — muzeý
• bank — bank
• train station — wokzal
• supermarket — uly dükan

Ýeri görkezmek:
• next to — ýanynda
• opposite — garşysynda
• between — arasynda

There is a park in my town. — Meniň şäherimde seýilgäh bar.
There are two schools. — Iki mekdep bar.
text.ru:
Слова о городе:
• school — школа
• hospital — больница
• library — библиотека
• park — парк
• museum — музей
• bank — банк
• train station — вокзал
• supermarket — супермаркет

Место:
• next to — рядом с
• opposite — напротив
• between — между

There is a park in my town. — В моём городе есть парк.
There are two schools. — Есть две школы.

text.tk:
Kiçijik tekst:
«I live in Balkanabat. There is a big park in my town. The library is next to my school. The bank is opposite the museum. There are many shops.»
Üns ber: bir zat — «There is», köp zat — «There are».
text.ru:
Небольшой текст:
«I live in Balkanabat. There is a big park in my town. The library is next to my school. The bank is opposite the museum. There are many shops.»
Обрати внимание: один предмет — «There is», много — «There are».

q.ru: Куда ты идёшь, чтобы взять книгу?

explain.tk: Library — kitaphana. Hospital — hassahana, bank — bank.
explain.ru: Library — библиотека. Hospital — больница, bank — банк.

q.tk: There ___ three parks in my town.
q.ru: There ___ three parks in my town.

explain.tk: Köplük bilen «There are»: There are three parks.
explain.ru: С множественным числом — «There are»: There are three parks.

explain.tk: Dogry. The bank is opposite the museum — Bank muzeýiň garşysynda.
explain.ru: Верно. The bank is opposite the museum — Банк напротив музея.

text.tk: Londonda 1863-nji ýylda dünýäde ilkinji metro açyldy. Iňlisler ony «the Underground» ýa-da «the Tube» diýip atlandyrýarlar.
text.ru: В 1863 году в Лондоне открылось первое в мире метро. Англичане называют его «the Underground» или «the Tube».

text.tk:
Dükanda gerekli sözler:
• shop — dükan
• price — baha
• cheap — arzan
• expensive — gymmat
• money — pul
• buy — satyn almak

Sözlemler:
• How much is this T-shirt? — Bu futbolka näçe?
• How much are these shoes? — Bu aýakgaplar näçe?
• It's 20 dollars. — 20 dollar.
• Can I have..., please? — ... alyp bilerinmi?
• Here you are. — Alyň.
text.ru:
Слова для магазина:
• shop — магазин
• price — цена
• cheap — дешёвый
• expensive — дорогой
• money — деньги
• buy — покупать

Фразы:
• How much is this T-shirt? — Сколько стоит эта футболка?
• How much are these shoes? — Сколько стоят эти туфли?
• It's 20 dollars. — 20 долларов.
• Can I have..., please? — Можно мне..., пожалуйста?
• Here you are. — Вот, пожалуйста.

text.tk:
Gepleşik:
— Hello! How much is this ball?
— It's 8 dollars.
— Can I have two balls, please?
— Yes. That's 16 dollars.
— Here you are. Thank you!
Hasap: 8 + 8 = 16.
Üns ber: bir zat — «How much is», köp zat — «How much are».
text.ru:
Диалог:
— Hello! How much is this ball?
— It's 8 dollars.
— Can I have two balls, please?
— Yes. That's 16 dollars.
— Here you are. Thank you!
Считаем: 8 + 8 = 16.
Обрати внимание: один предмет — «How much is», несколько — «How much are».

explain.tk: Köplük bilen «are»: How much are these apples?
explain.ru: С множественным числом — «are»: How much are these apples?

q.tk: A pen is 3 dollars. How much are 5 pens? (diňe san)
q.ru: A pen is 3 dollars. How much are 5 pens? (только число)

q.tk: Satyjy zady berende «Here you are» diýýär.
q.ru: Продавец, отдавая покупку, говорит «Here you are».

hint.tk: Bu sözlem bir zady uzadanda aýdylýar.
hint.ru: Эту фразу говорят, когда что-то протягивают.

text.tk: Ilkinji kagyz pullar Gadymy Hytaýda peýda bolupdyr. Ondan öň adamlar söwdada metal teňňeleri, hatda deňiz gabyklaryny hem ulanypdyrlar.
text.ru: Первые бумажные деньги появились в Древнем Китае. До этого люди платили металлическими монетами и даже ракушками.

text.tk:
Hünärler:
• teacher — mugallym
• doctor — lukman
• driver — sürüji
• farmer — daýhan
• cook — aşpez
• pilot — uçarman
• engineer — inžener
• builder — gurluşykçy

Sorag we jogap:
• What does your dad do? — Kakaň näme iş edýär?
• He is an engineer. — Ol inžener.
• She is a doctor. — Ol lukman.
Üns ber: hünäriň öňünde «a» ýa-da çekimliden öň «an».
text.ru:
Профессии:
• teacher — учитель
• doctor — врач
• driver — водитель
• farmer — фермер
• cook — повар
• pilot — пилот
• engineer — инженер
• builder — строитель

Вопрос и ответ:
• What does your dad do? — Кем работает твой папа?
• He is an engineer. — Он инженер.
• She is a doctor. — Она врач.
Обрати внимание: перед профессией ставим «a», а перед гласной — «an».

text.tk:
Kim nirede işleýär?
1) A teacher works at a school.
2) A doctor works at a hospital.
3) A farmer works on a farm.
4) A cook works in a restaurant.
Köp hünärler «-er» bilen gutarýar: teach → teacher, drive → driver, build → builder.
text.ru:
Кто где работает?
1) A teacher works at a school.
2) A doctor works at a hospital.
3) A farmer works on a farm.
4) A cook works in a restaurant.
Многие профессии оканчиваются на «-er»: teach → teacher, drive → driver, build → builder.

explain.tk: A doctor works at a hospital — Lukman hassahanada işleýär.
explain.ru: A doctor works at a hospital — Врач работает в больнице.

text.tk: Hünärleriň köpüsi iňlis familiýalaryna öwrülipdir: Smith (demirçi), Baker (çörekçi), Taylor (dikinçi), Cook (aşpez). Gadymda adamlar şeýle familiýalary hünärine görä alypdyrlar.
text.ru: Многие профессии стали английскими фамилиями: Smith (кузнец), Baker (пекарь), Taylor (портной), Cook (повар). Раньше люди получали такие фамилии по своему ремеслу.
